gen-gf-gugi-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big holds a calm, unvarying weight from word to word. Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to the capitals and its cut-open terminals let the counters flow outward, a distinctive heading against a quiet body.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Eater bites with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, wide gaps between letters, and ascenders kept short. Eater does menace best; Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau does open curves.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads modern and unfussy, its tall x-height crowding the ascenders while curves stay open. And a whole page of it would read steadily, giving Flavors' whimsical, commanding strokes somewhere to rest.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Futuristic is the right word for Audiowide, its neon-tube letters held to one steady line thickness. Noto Sans Bamum does the plain reading work, its big open counters letting Audiowide carry the glow.
gen-almendra-display-gf-julius-sans-one: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display keeps its letters open and its x-height pronounced. Julius Sans One stays at a single pen width with generous spacing, and that gap in temperament is the pair's pull.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-roboto: Autour One is expressive and bold, its stems and arcs moving in lockstep with no hairline shift. And Roboto, with generous mouths on its round letters, echoes that uniformity, which is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro holds a calm, unvarying weight from word to word. Funnel Display's spaghetti-like strokes make the heading expressive, yet both fonts keep lowercase close to capital height, which is what unites them.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-archivo: Archivo brings an editorial, approachable voice, its curves opening outward and its commanding x-height standing taller than the heading's. Happy Monkey's ruler-straight, bold strokes are the quality that makes the pair distinct.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-asap: Asap reads smoothly, its body height nearly matching the capitals. Happy Monkey's bold, distinctive heading keeps a monoweight stroke throughout, and that shared trait is what ties it to Asap.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Happy Monkey draws bold, ruler-straight strokes with wide gaps in the e, sitting at a moderate lowercase height. Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans, stands taller and lets the heading shout.
